en.summary: Fixes CSR stall propagation so backpressure reflects CSR-slot occupancy rather than transient request valid state.
why_it_counts: The patch changes a control output in a central CSR pipeline RTL block.
The modified predicate directly affects when the upstream GPR or issue side is forced to stall.
No test-only or infrastructure-only files are involved.
disqualifiers: The commit message is terse and does not describe the failing test scenario in detail.
evidence: VX_csr_pipe.v changes stall_gpr_csr from no_slot_csr && csr_req_if.is_csr && (| csr_req_if.valid) to just no_slot_csr.
The same file stalls the CSR pipeline register on no_slot_csr, so the slot-busy condition already exists independently of the incoming request valid bits.
stall_gpr_csr is the exported backpressure signal from the CSR pipeline module.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The fix removes an incorrect dependency between an occupancy-derived stall and the instantaneous valid state of the incoming CSR request. In a pipelined control unit, once a dedicated CSR slot or stage is busy, upstream logic must continue to see that occupancy until the slot is genuinely free. If stall is gated by the live request-valid bits instead, backpressure can disappear one cycle too early while the slot is still occupied.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A CSR stage remains occupied or unavailable while the incoming CSR request valid signal drops, changes lanes, or is momentarily deasserted.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Make the exported stall depend on current request-valid qualifiers in addition to the slot-busy condition.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: gate occupancy stall with transient request-valid predicate
portability_notes: This maps to any specialized pipeline that has a busy slot signal and a separate upstream stall signal.
The core fault is allowing a persistent resource-busy condition to be masked by front-end request-valid timing.
You do not need a CSR unit specifically; the same mutation applies to any serialized side pipeline.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the signal that tells upstream logic to stall because a serialized CSR or control stage has no free slot.
Add an extra condition so that stall only asserts when the incoming request is currently marked valid or currently decoded as that operation class.
Leave the internal busy or no-slot condition unchanged so the resource can still be occupied even while the exported stall drops.
Keep the rest of the pipeline state machine intact so the bug appears as a protocol mismatch rather than a larger redesign.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: stall_gpr_csr generation in the CSR pipe
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit removes csr_req_if.is_csr and csr_req_if.valid from stall_gpr_csr so the signal is driven only by no_slot_csr.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_csr_pipe, change stall_gpr_csr back from no_slot_csr to no_slot_csr && csr_req_if.is_csr && (| csr_req_if.valid).

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Upstream issue logic can stop stalling even though the CSR path is still occupied, which can lead to dropped, overwritten, or misordered CSR operations and intermittent pipeline control failures.
evidence_for_injection: The only behavioral change is the one-line stall predicate in VX_csr_pipe.v.
The module already stalls its internal CSR register on no_slot_csr, showing that slot occupancy persists independently of csr_req_if.valid.
The fix leaves all other CSR dataflow intact, which makes this a clean control-path injection point.
notes: The exact failure signature depends on how the surrounding issue logic consumes stall_gpr_csr.
This is still a real DUT control fix even though the commit message is minimal.

zh.summary: 该修复让 CSR 的 stall 传播反映实际的 CSR 槽位占用，而不是依赖瞬时的请求 valid 状态。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了核心 CSR pipeline RTL 模块中的控制输出。
这个判定直接影响上游 GPR 或 issue 侧何时必须停顿。
没有涉及任何仅测试或仅基础设施的文件。
disqualifiers: 提交信息很简短，没有详细说明触发失败的测试场景。
evidence: VX_csr_pipe.v 把 stall_gpr_csr 从 no_slot_csr && csr_req_if.is_csr && (| csr_req_if.valid) 改成了仅由 no_slot_csr 驱动。
同一个文件里 CSR pipeline 寄存器本身就是在 no_slot_csr 条件下停住的，说明槽位繁忙这一条件本来就独立于输入 valid。
stall_gpr_csr 是 CSR pipeline 模块向外输出的反压信号。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该修复移除了一个错误依赖：把基于资源占用的 stall 绑定到瞬时输入 valid 状态。在流水化控制单元中，只要专用 CSR 槽位或阶段仍然繁忙，上游就必须持续看到这一占用状态，直到槽位真正释放。如果 stall 同时依赖实时请求 valid，那么即使槽位仍被占用，反压也可能过早消失一个周期。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: CSR 阶段仍然被占用或不可用，但输入 CSR 请求 valid 瞬间拉低、换 lane 或暂时撤销。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让向上游输出的 stall 同时依赖当前请求 valid 等限定条件，而不是只依赖槽位繁忙。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 用瞬时 request-valid 条件去门控占用 stall
portability_notes: 这可映射到任何既有 busy-slot 信号、又有独立上游 stall 信号的专用流水线。
核心错误是：允许一个持续存在的资源繁忙状态被前端 request-valid 时序掩盖。
不一定非要是 CSR 单元；任何串行化的旁路流水线都可以注入同类故障。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到用于通知上游“因为串行化 CSR 或控制阶段没有空槽位而必须停顿”的信号。
给该 stall 信号增加额外条件，使其只有在当前输入请求被标记为 valid 或被当前解码为该操作类型时才拉高。
保持内部 busy 或 no-slot 条件不变，这样资源仍会被占用，但对外导出的 stall 可能提前消失。
其余流水线状态机保持不变，让故障表现为协议不一致，而不是更大的结构性改写。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSR pipe 中 stall_gpr_csr 的生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交从 stall_gpr_csr 中去掉了 csr_req_if.is_csr 和 csr_req_if.valid，使其只由 no_slot_csr 驱动。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_csr_pipe 中，把 stall_gpr_csr 从 no_slot_csr 改回 no_slot_csr && csr_req_if.is_csr && (| csr_req_if.valid)。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 即使 CSR 路径仍然被占用，上游 issue 逻辑也可能停止 stall，从而造成 CSR 操作丢失、覆盖、乱序，或产生间歇性的控制路径错误。
evidence_for_injection: 唯一的行为变化就是 VX_csr_pipe.v 中这一行 stall 谓词。
模块内部的 CSR 寄存器本来就会在 no_slot_csr 时停住，说明槽位占用状态独立存在，不依赖 csr_req_if.valid。
修复没有改动其他 CSR 数据通路，因此这是一个很干净的控制路径注入点。
notes: 具体错误表现取决于周围 issue 逻辑如何消费 stall_gpr_csr。
尽管提交信息较少，这仍然是一个真实的 DUT 控制修复。
